===Farming===
====Haiju Lagoon====
This can be run by solo players from [[Zen Daijun (outpost)|Zen Daijun]]. The coast has roaming Nagas from one end to the other. Fight groups of three and ensure to kill the [[Naga Bone Collector]]s first, which use [[Spirit Rift]]. The peninsula to the East is patrolled by [[Tin Dao Kaineng]] and two groups. You can avoid fighting these as they won't halt your farming but if strong enough to deal with them, wait until they split or use [[daze]] skills to counter their attacks.
